claims.text: A platform that makes bond-market products accessible to retail investors in India. Early on it was run almost manually.
Risks recorded by the fund: Regulation of retail access to debt products. Trust is slow to build in a category where mistakes cost real money. Early volumes were small.

Partner assessment of founders from the meeting: Ajinkya Kulkarni, founder and CEO. His early approach is what we backed: he and his co-founders talked to prospective users directly, explained bonds to them, ran a basic lead-generation website and arranged transactions by hand, even joining intro calls themselves. We read that as the right instinct. They did not build a product around an assumption; they sat across the table from the customer first. Concern: the early manual model had no obvious scale mechanism, and the regulatory perimeter for retail bond distribution was evolving.
